summary: The OVOS skill fleet's own gold intent corpus: the test split of OpenVoiceOS/ovos-intents at tag v6.1, 2,380 utterances over 21 locales labelled with the canonical skill ids a real device registers. One row is an utterance and the intent it should fire.
notes: Re-pointed from the retired OpenVoiceOS/ovos-intents-v5-eval, which the OpenVoiceOS/ovos-intents card lists as superseded, to the test split at tag v6.1: 2,380 gold rows over 21 locales. The v5 id_test/ood buckets do not exist in the successor, so no bucket is declared and the ranked metric follows the default bucket handling. Labels are '<skill_id>:<intent_name>' with v6.1 intent names; intent heads trained on the v5 corpus (the m2v-v5-* fighters) can emit only their v5 label set, and labels renamed since then score as misses. The matching template training corpus stays ovos-intents-v5-templates-train.
